__NOTOC__ {{Infobox map |name=Aerowalk |year=February 21, 1998 |image=aerowalk.jpg |creator={{player|Preacher|flag=se}} |gametype=1on1, 2on2, FFA |size=Medium |family=[[TB5]] |download=https://maps.quakeworld.nu/all/aerowalk.bsp }} Created and released by {{player|Preacher|flag=se}} in February 21, 1998, '''Aerowalk''' is one of the two custom maps included in the [[TB5]] pool for 1on1 play alongside [[Ztndm3]]. Aerowalk is the most popular of the pair in most regions, but not all — notably in Russia. Due to its wide popularity, it has been ported to many other games. Aerowalk was created using the [[WorldCraft]] editor. {{quote|Medium sized level especially made for furious 1on1 play =)|Preacher}} {{MapItems |quad=1 |ring= |pent= |hp100=1 |ra=1 |ya=1 |ga=2 |lg=1 |rl=2 |gl=1 |sng=2 |ng=0 |ssg=0 }} ==Gallery== File:Aero lg.jpg File:Aero lowrl.jpg File:Aero quad.jpg == How to Play == === 1on1 === Aerowalk favors a fast, rushed strategical and technical approach, has RA, YA, and Mega control points, and favors utilization of teleporters for shot placement. Refer to [[Inertia]]'s guide on [https://www.quakeworld.nu/forum/topic/2131/aerowalk-strategy-by-inertia the forum]. {{#ev:youtube|834s5YjMb0U|300}} === Free for All === Just for fun, used in most ffa rotations. An armored [[Quad]] carrier can really wreak havoc here.
